ticket_text: Add pagination to the listings search endpoint so results come back 20 at a time.
problem: Search endpoint returns all listings, causing performance issues.
acceptance_criteria: API returns 20 listings per page by default.
Client can request specific page via page parameter.
Total count is included in response header or body.
edge_cases: Page number less than 1 defaults to 1.
Page number beyond max returns empty list.
test_cases: Request page=999 returns empty array when no listings.
